create_ssim_loss: create a function that computes structural similarity index between two image batches as a differentiable loss
create_ms_ssim_loss: create a function that computes multi-scale structural similarity index between two image batches
build_ssim_module: build a PyTorch nn.Module that wraps SSIM computation and returns the negative SSIM as a loss
